vadsrijk.z4bazen.tip.vliegervanger: Is he hanging under his kite? Right-click the 3 winches on the deck (3x each) to bring him down. Yellow = catch a plushie together!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.tip.zeeslurf: Red = his snoot or a sulk cloud. In phase 2 he dives into his little grotto: dive after him and break the 3 gray polyps. Pink bubble rings give air!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.fase2.ond: Reel in the winches to bring his kite down!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.immuun: He's hanging too high! Reel in the 3 winches on the deck (right-click).
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.knuffel: A plushie falls out of his sack! Catch it TOGETHER in the yellow circle!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.lieren: He's hanging from his kite! Right-click the 3 winches (purple flag) 3 times each.
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.neer: CRACK! The kite crashes down! Pinkie is flat on his back for a moment: hit him now!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.onder: He steals plushies. With a kite.
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.zeg.op: Ha! Catch me if you can, landlubbers! My kite is faster than you!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.vliegervanger.zeg.weg: This is going in my report! The Emperor will hear about this!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.aaien: Pet him together! Everyone stand in the yellow circle!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.adem: He surfaces, gasping for air! Hit him now!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.blij: The Sea Snoot is pink again! He sings a song for the whole lagoon.
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.duik: The Sea Snoot sinks to his little grotto! Dive to the 3 gray polyps (pink rings = air).
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.fase2.onder: Dive after him and break the gray polyps!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.fase3.onder: Out of the red ring, or dive under it!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.giechel: Hee hee hee! He gets the giggles and forgets to swim for a moment!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.golf: Big wave! Out of the red ring!
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.immuun: He's deep in his little grotto! Break the gray polyps first.
vadsrijk.z4bazen.zeeslurf.onder: He's been sulking at the bottom of the lagoon for years
vadsrijk.z4boot.alleen_water: Your little sailboat only sails on water (and you don't have a land mount yet).
vadsrijk.z4boot.bron.beloning: A reward somewhere on the Lantern Coast...
vadsrijk.z4boot.fles.uitleg: Right-click: the guh sailboat is yours! Call it with your mount key in the water of the Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.z4boot.geen_plek: No room for your boat here: find open water (3x3, with air above).
vadsrijk.z4boot.geen_vreemde_boot: Other boats don't float here: in the Chonkdom you sail your own guh sailboat.
vadsrijk.z4boot.nieuw_variant: New for your little sailboat: %s! Pick it in the Little Sailboat screen.
vadsrijk.z4boot.scherm.nog_niet: You get your own little sailboat early in the story of the Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.z4boot.scherm.uitleg: %s in the water or on a dock = your boat. W = hoist the sail, S = brake, A/D = steer. You go faster with the wind behind you. Shift at a dock = moor.
vadsrijk.z4boot.stroming: The Ring Current pushes your boat back toward the islands!
vadsrijk.z4boot.terug_steiger: You logged out at sea. Your boat is safely back in the harbor: you're standing on the dock of %s.
vadsrijk.z4boot.tip.boot: Stand in the water or on a dock and press your mount key (X): there's your boat. With N (Sailboat tab) you can dress it up.
vadsrijk.z4boot.tip.varen: W = hoist the sail (you keep speeding up), S = brake, A/D = steer. The wind shifts: you go faster with the wind behind you. At a dock: Shift = moor. At the edge, the Ring Current pushes you back.
vadsrijk.z4dieren.dobber.af_steiger: You step off onto the Turtle Island dock.
vadsrijk.z4dieren.dobber.af_water: Splash! You're swimming next to Old Bobber. Click him to climb back on.
vadsrijk.z4dieren.dobber.gered: Old Bobber fishes you out of the water. Phew, catch your breath!
vadsrijk.z4dieren.dobber.halte: Old Bobber is waiting at the Turtle Island dock. Click him to swim along!
vadsrijk.z4dieren.dobber.op: Old Bobber takes you along on his round! (sneak = get off)
vadsrijk.z4dieren.dobber.terug: Old Bobber is back at the dock. Hop off if you like!
vadsrijk.z4dieren.dobber.vertrek: Old Bobber swims off again... bob, bob.
vadsrijk.z4dieren.dobber.vol: Old Bobber is full. Wait for the next round!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.aankomst: Welcome to Lanternhaven! Harbormaster Anchor is waiting on the quay, by the middle dock.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.dans.klaar: You dance the wave, the crab and the whale! Everyone around the campfire claps.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.dans.start: The campfire crackles. Your feet start moving all by themselves...
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.fles.alle: All the bottle messages read. Together, the notes tell of an Emperor who never has enough, far in the east.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.fles.fles_1: 'They say the Emperor never sleeps. He sits on his throne and waits for the Bowl to be full. It has never been full.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.fles.fles_2: 'Dear whoever finds this: are plushies allowed where you are? Not here. They say it's a waste of chonk.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.fles.fles_3: 'Order from the Ring Finger: count all the lanterns on the west coast. Twice. Whatever is warm goes east.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.fles.fles_4: 'Soup without chonk: water, a stone, and silence. Stir until you forget what soup tasted like.' Someone has drawn a little heart underneath.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.fles.fles_5: 'If you share your nibble, the Emperor comes to get you...' Below it, in different handwriting: 'I share anyway. Yum.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.fles.fles_6: A hand-drawn map: a long road to the east, a castle like a bowl, and a little crown above it. Next to it is written: 'Neverenough.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.fles.titel.fles_6: A Map of the East Coast
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.flessenpost.weg: You toss the bottle message into the Ring Current. It bobs away, to the east. Off you go, little bottle. To Granny.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.groot.roze: The big plushie sighs, and slowly turns pink. It feels lighter now that its story has been told.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.knuffel.alle: All twelve plushies of Snuggletide are pink again!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.knuffel.opgevrolijkt: The plushie turns a little pink. (%s of %s plushies of Snuggletide)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.lens.bezig: You polish the big lens. Salt off, shine on...
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.lens.klaar: The lens gleams! The lighthouse's light reaches all the way to the mist again.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.mistbrief.mistbrief_1: 'Day 1. We walk at night. In the daytime the Mikas stand by the pipes. Mama says: don't look, don't talk, just walk.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.mistbrief.mistbrief_2: 'Day 9. We saw a village by a pipe. Everything gray. A guh sat on a doorstep, staring at nothing. He didn't wave back.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.mistbrief.mistbrief_3: 'Day 20. The sea! Plushies in the water, all drifting the same way. To the west. We're going with them.'
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.al: You just had one! Finish it first, then you get another.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.limonade: Here you go, a glass of seashell lemonade. With a seagrass straw.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.soep: Here you go, a little bowl of soup. There's always more.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.vissoep: Here you go, a bowl of fish soup. Careful, it's hot. With a shrimp in it. It's waving.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.zeilboot: Your little sailboat is waiting at the dock! (If the boat isn't in this version yet: it's on its way.)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.rol.zeilboot.nog: The little sailboat is still being built. Until then: swim, or cross via the little sandbanks. I'll keep an eye on you.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.cliff.0: The airship casts off from the Liftoff Pier. Slowly it rises, past the head of Mother Cloudwhale.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.cliff.1: Her eye turns to follow. She looks at you. As big as a house, as soft as a blanket.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.cliff.2: Above the clouds: towers with little flags, little bridges, a cathedral of cloudstone. Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.cliff.3: Down on the pier, a guh in a white-and-gold cape watches the ship go. A gray bit of fluff drifts out of his sleeve.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.cliff.vervolg: To be continued... Highchonk, the Floating City.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.feest.0: The lanterns light up. Three hundred of them, pink, yellow and mint. And one lilac.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.feest.1: Twelve kites with little ears rise up, and from each kite hangs a plushie, waving down.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.feest.2: Graysie sees a plushie on a kite. "MOUSE!" She runs over. Mouse is pink. So is Graysie, a little.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.feest.3: Everyone dances. Grandpa Slim too. He laughs. At nothing. Just laughing.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.feest.4: Foster Mom Softie taps her lemonade glass: "Whoever washes up here is home. Plushie or guh. Welcome home."
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.mist.0: Through the gate you see... nothing. Only mist. And then, very softly, the sound of cartwheels.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.mist.1: A long gray road. Carts full of plushies and lanterns, pulled by Mikas with sacks. They're all heading east.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.mist.2: Along the road hums a gray pipe. It sucks. Wherever it runs, the flowers lose their color.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.mist.3: Far away, on the horizon, stands a castle like a bowl. Above it hangs a moon that isn't a moon. It watches.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.mist.4: The mist closes in again. Your ears are cold. Behind you, a voice: "...Are you a Mika?"
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.opening.eilande: Little islands like beads on a string. Kites. Parasols. A lighthouse with little ears.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.opening.knuffel: On a little beach in the southeast, gray specks lie in the surf. Plushies. Gray plushies.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.opening.onder: A pink sea full of little islands
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.opening.walvis: And above the sea, in the east, a city floats. On the back of a whale.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.opening.wolkenv: The airship dives through the Cloudfall. Below the clouds: a pink sea, and lanterns as far as the eye can see.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.wolkwal.0: It goes quiet. An enormous shadow glides across the water.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.wolkwal.1: Mother Cloudwhale sinks down through the clouds. Low. Very low. On her back twinkle the lights of Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.wolkwal.2: She sings. A long, deep whale song you can feel in your tummy. The lanterns sway along.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.scene.wolkwal.3: Her eye is big and kind. And tired. Behind her tail flutters a thin gray wisp.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.schat.duintop: Under the beach grass on top of the Lantern Dune lies a chest. With sand in it. And under the sand: treasure.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.schat.lagune: On the bottom of the lagoon, among the pink coral, stands a little chest with a lock shaped like a seashell.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.schat.mist: Behind the gray gate, half in the mist, stands a chest someone left behind as they fled. There's still something warm inside.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.schat.vliegertop: A little chest hangs from a kite at the contest pole. It's been flying for years. Nobody thought to reel it in.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.groot_1.ve: I come from a city where all the windows are shut. Posters hang there: THIN IS PRETTY. QUIET IS QUICK.
My guh lived in a little house by a gray pipe. Every night that pipe hummed. It sucked something away. The warmth.
One day the Mikas came with sacks. All the plushies had to go. 'For the Bowl.' My guh didn't cry. That wasn't allowed.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.groot_2.ve: I saw the road. A long gray road, straight to the east. Carts rode along it. Day and night.
In the carts were plushies, lanterns, music boxes. Everything warm. Everything went east.
At the end of the road stood a castle. So big the clouds had to go around it. Everything went inside. And nothing ever came out.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.groot_3.ve: I was loaded onto a ship. A gray ship, with gray sails. There were lots of them. A whole fleet.
The captain wore rings on her toes. She counted everything. Every plushie. Every lantern. Twice.
A storm came. The ship tipped over. I slid out, into the sea. I drifted away. I was happy.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.groot_4.ve: I'm just a plushie. But I saw something nobody was allowed to see.
A hall. Gray light. A throne. And on the armrest... five skinny little fingers. Tap. Tap. Tap. Tap. Tap.
A slow voice said: 'More.' Just that. 'More.' And then I was put in a sack. Bye-bye, throne.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.strand_1.v: I belong to Graysie. She held me every night. Then a Mika came with a sack. I was so scared.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.strand_2.v: Quack. I drifted for a very long time. The water got warmer and warmer. And then... pink! Am I home?
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.strand_3.v: In my old house I wasn't allowed on the windowsill. 'Plushies are a waste of chonk,' they said.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.strand_4.v: I have one ear. The other one is still in the gray land. But with one ear I can hear you too.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.strand_5.v: We lay in a cart by the hundreds. All silent. Then I fell off. Splash. Lucky me.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.strand_6.v: My little light stopped working. Look... now it's blinking a little again!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.wrak_1.ver: That Mika with the kite snatched me off the clothesline. I wasn't even dry yet!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.tijknuffel.wrak_2.ver: He wanted to fly us to the east. 'A bonus from the Ring Finger,' he said. Who's that?
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.uitzicht.duin: Behind you stands the Tree, as big as a mountain. Before you the little islands glitter. And above the sea floats Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.uitzicht.pierkop: Above your head, Mother Cloudwhale swims through the sky. On her back: towers, little bridges and lights. Highchonk.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.uitzicht.vlieger: The wind blows so hard here your ears flap. You can see all the little islands at once, like beads on a string.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.uitzicht.vuurtoren: Far in the southeast, the Gray Fog Bank hangs like a wall. Behind it... something gray begins.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vind.bijtjes: Buzz! A little bee flies back with you. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vind.bloemen: A beautiful flower for the garlands. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vind.lampionhaken: You hang up a lantern. It lights up all by itself! (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vind.mistbrieven: A note from Misty, damp from the mist. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vind.vliegerspul: Found it! Another piece for your kite. (%s/%s)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vis.gevangen: A pink fish! (%s of %s for Fisher Bobber)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vlieger.geen: You don't have a guh kite with you. Kitemaker Pennant will help you build one.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vlieger.gewonnen: Half a minute! Your kite dances high above the island. You won the contest!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vlieger.start: You launch your guh kite at the contest pole. Up it shoots! Keep it in the wind...
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vlieger.weg: You walked away from the contest pole. The kite sinks. Start over!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.vlieger.windstoot: A gust of wind! Your kite loops the loop. Wind Master Swoosh claps. (%s seconds)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.gewonnen: You win! Three points! Smash falls over backwards in the sand in surprise.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.hint.0: Smash looks to the right... but his left ear is wiggling.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.hint.1: Smash looks straight ahead and whistles a tune. Very innocent.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.hint.2: Smash looks to the left. Very obviously to the left. Too obviously. And his right ear is wiggling.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.mis: Miss! The ball flomps into the sand. Smash cheers. For himself.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.punt: Got it! You dive into the sand and hit the ball back. Point for you!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.serve: Smash tosses the ball up... (%s - %s) Where will he hit it?
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.volley.uitleg: (Tip: watch Smash's ears. Ears never lie.)
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.wrak.0: Hey! Who dares disturb Pinkie the Kite Catcher in his own wreck? This is a private wreck!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.wrak.1: Those plushies? I... found them. On a clothesline. They were just hanging there. That's practically throwing them away.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.wrak.2: The Ring Finger pays a bonus for every plushie. Two plushies is two bonuses. I'm very good at math.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.wrak.3: Pinkie hoists his gray war kite, but the string is tied to his own tail. He flies one loop, and splashes into the sea.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.wrak.4: "This goes in my report!" He swims off, as fast as a Mika swims. Which is not fast. Down in the hold lie the plushies.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.zeeslurf.0: In the deepest little grotto lies a giant sea cow with a long snoot. He blows gray bubbles. They pop without a sound.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.zeeslurf.1: You swim closer and pet his snoot. He startles. Then... he blinks. One pink bubble. Two. Ten!
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.zeeslurf.2: The Sea Snoot sings a low, happy song. The little fish come back and play with his bubbles.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.zeilboot.klaar: You have your very own little guh sailboat! The sail winks at you.
vadsrijk.z4verhaal.zone4.klaar: Snuggletide is over and all the plushies are pink! From now on, the airship to Highchonk departs from the Liftoff Pier.
vadsrijk.z4wereld.kringstroom: The Ring Current gently pushes you back toward the little islands...
vadsrijk.z4wezens.set.lampion.4: (4) Party Light: +10 Heal Power, and you glow in the dark yourself
vadsrijk.z4wezens.set.stukken: Set: %s (%s/4 worn; the set mittens or cape count too)
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.bromvlieger: Purple stripe = a gust of wind that blows you away. When he swoops low, his tail swishes.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.koraalkobold: He throws coral shards from a distance. Run up to him: up close he's a pushover.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.lampionkwal: Red circle under the jelly = its tentacles sting. Step out, then strike back.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.mistmopje: He melts away into the mist and pops up behind you. See the red circle? Get out of it, or things go dark for a bit.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.mokmeeuw: Red stripe = his dive. Sidestep! Afterwards he sits on the ground for a moment: that's your chance.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.mopperkrab: Holding his claws in front of his face? Then hits from the front only do half. Walk around him!
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.pruilrob: Drumming his flippers? Then he slides on his belly along the red stripe. Step aside!
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.stekelpluis: He does nothing until you do something. Red circle = his spikes: step away for a moment.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.vliegerknecht: A Mika with a grappling hook. Red stripe = his hook: step aside, or you'll get Sticky.
vadsrijk.z4wezens.tip.zeurslak: His slime trail makes you Sticky. Crawling into his shell? Wait a moment, he'll come back out.
